name: libauth-native
description: Native (C) crypto backend that makes @bitauth/libauth, @xo-cash/engine and @xo-cash/templates run in React Native / Expo
author: Salem Mohammed Shamakh

scripts.test:host: mkdir -p build && cc -O2 -std=c99 -Icpp/secp256k1 -Icpp/secp256k1/src cpp/lan_hashes.c cpp/lan_secp256k1.c cpp/lan_secp256k1_impl.c test/host/harness.c -o build/harness && node test/host/compare-with-wasm.mjs build/harness
